js: window.UP=()=>{ if (document.getElementById('pause').classList.contains('on')) G.pause(false); }; setInterval(UP, 250); window.LOOK=async(x,y,z)=>{const c=G.camera,d=new c.position.constructor(),f=()=>new Promise(r=>requestAnimationFrame(r));let p=0;for(let i=0;i<6;i++){G.yaw=Math.atan2(-(x-c.position.x),-(z-c.position.z));G.pitch=p;await f();await f();await f();c.getWorldDirection(d);const w=new c.position.constructor(x,y,z).sub(c.position).normalize();p+=(Math.asin(d.y)-Math.asin(w.y))*0.9;}return 1;}; G.setCh('herd'); G.time(12); G.killcam.mode('every'); 1

for (const [k,n] of [['wood',2],['fiber',8],['hide',2],['stick',2],['flint',2]]) G.give(k,n); const R=(id)=>G.RECIPES.find(r=>r.id===id); G.craft(R('bow')); G.craft(R('quiver')); G.craft(R('arrows')); G.craft(R('arrows')); UP(); G.tp(40,30); G.N.pos.set(20,0,10); for (const a of G.animals.slice()) if (!a.tame && !a.horse && Math.hypot(a.root.position.x-40,a.root.position.z-30)<80) G.remove(a); 1
UP(); window.DEER=G.spawn('deer', G.P.pos.x, G.P.pos.z+20); DEER.stun=1e6; DEER.root.rotation.y=Math.PI/2; 1

(async()=>{ const p=DEER.root.position; G.bow.aim(); await LOOK(p.x, p.y+0.75, p.z); window.AR=await G.bow.shoot(1); window.KCLOG=[]; window._kl=setInterval(()=>KCLOG.push([G.killcam.KC.ph, +G.killcam.KC.k.toFixed(3)]),100); return [!!AR, G.killcam.KC.on]; })()

name: a strike on game starts the arrow cam: slow motion, letterbox

js: clearInterval(_kl); JSON.stringify({st:AR.st, o:AR.o&&AR.o.kind, deer:DEER.state, hp:DEER.hp, fov:G.camera.fov, cine:document.getElementById('hud').classList.contains('cine'), phases:[...new Set(KCLOG.map(x=>x[0]))]})

name: the arrow struck the deer; the cam ends and play resumes

js: (async()=>{ const p=DEER2.root.position; G.bow.aim(); await LOOK(p.x, p.y+0.75, p.z); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,2600)); window.AR2=await G.bow.shoot(1); return G.killcam.KC.on; })()

name: second strike: the cam is running
any key skips the arrow cam

js: G.killcam.mode('off'); UP(); G.remove(DEER2); window.DEER3=G.spawn('deer', G.P.pos.x, G.P.pos.z-19); DEER3.stun=1e6; (async()=>{ const p=DEER3.root.position; G.bow.aim(); await LOOK(p.x, p.y+0.75, p.z); await G.bow.shoot(1); return G.killcam.KC.on; })()
